data.name: Husani
data.gender_notes: Husani is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Husani is derived from the Arabic word husn, meaning 'goodness' or 'beauty'. This name is a compound of husn and ani, which together mean 'friend of God'. In Islamic tradition, the name is often given to children as a reminder of their connection to Allah and as a symbol of righteousness and piety. The name Husani carries the meaning “Friend of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Husani usually hope their child will grow to embody friend of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes devotion and closeness to Allah.
data.etymology: Husani belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Husani total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
